name: THEOPHYLLINE / AMBROXOL 0.7/0.15 GR SOLUTION 150 ML 1 PIECE
description: Theophylline/Ambroxol solution is a medication that acts as a bronchodilator and mucolytic. It is used to treat respiratory conditions characterized by bronchospasm (narrowing of the airways) and difficulty expelling excess mucus and phlegm. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
